item.title: Evaluating the Eurozone’s Impact on Portugal Amidst Modern Uncertainties
item.description: This paper investigates the impact of euro area membership on the Portuguese economy, focusing on whether the benefits of integration have outweighed the costs amidst ongoing economic uncertainties. Earlier research employed a VAR model with a discrete change in 1999 to capture the impact of adopting the euro. Instead, this paper uses a Smooth Transition Vector Autoregressive (STVAR) model. item.description: The 1992 Maastricht Treaty, laid the foundations for the current European Union with its single market in goods, services, capital and labour and established the framework for the creation of the single currency. item.title: Economic and Monetary Union: What Kind of Convergence?
item.description: This paper explores the complexities of convergence within the European Union, focusing on both nominal and real convergence in the context of the Economic and Monetary Union (EMU). The authors revisit the theoretical underpinnings of monetary integration, drawing from Optimal Currency Area (OCA) theory and its evolution, while analysing the benefits and costs of membership in a monetary union. item.title: Building Up Legitimacy? Analysis of the European Central Bank Narrative During the COVID-19 Crisis
item.description: For the literature on crisis management, two of the most important undertakings are sense-making (what is going on) and meaning-making (causes and consequences; and solutions). They feed the public’s understanding and support of crisis responses.
